---@type PluginSet.Core.Logger
local logger = LoggerManager.GetLogger("UIManager")

local function logWarn(...)
    logger:Warn(...)
end

local function logError(...)
    logger:Error(...)
end

local UIManagerNative = PluginSet.FGUI.UIManager

---@class UIManager: PluginSet.FGUI.UIManager
local UIManager = class("UIManager")
setmetatable(UIManager, { __index = UIManagerNative })

---@class IWindowInfo
---@field name string
---@field classname string
---@field isSingleton boolean
---@field tag number
---@field class UIWindowBase

---@type table<string, IWindowInfo>
local s_windowInfos = {}

---@type table<string, any>
local s_lockFlags = {}

local LayerView
local LayerModal
local LayerToast
local LayerLoading

---InitWithSafeArea
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param w number
---@param h number
function UIManager.InitWithSafeArea(x, y, w, h)
    UIManagerNative.InitWithSafeArea(x, y, w, h)
    
    UIManager.Init()
end

function UIManager.Init()
    LayerView    = UIManagerNative.LayerView
    LayerModal   = UIManagerNative.LayerModal
    LayerToast   = UIManagerNative.LayerToast
    LayerLoading = UIManagerNative.LayerLoading
end

---RegisterWindow
---@param name string
---@param classname string
---@param isSingleton boolean default is true
---@param tag number default is 0
function UIManager.RegisterWindow(name, classname, isSingleton, tag)
    --if s_windowInfos[name] then
    --    return logError("UIManager.Register: has already a window named {0}", name)
    --end
    s_windowInfos[name] = {
        name = name,
        classname = classname,
        isSingleton = isSingleton ~= false,
        tag = tag or 0,
    }
end

---FindWindow
---@param name string
---@return UIWindow
function UIManager.FindWindow(name)
    local info = s_windowInfos[name]
    local cls = info and info.class
    if not cls then return nil end
    return cls:GetInstance() or nil
end

--public static bool IsWindowShown(string name, bool isStrict = true)

---IsWindowShown
---@param name string
---@param isStrict boolean|nil default true
---@return boolean
function UIManager.IsWindowShown(name, isStrict)
    isStrict = isStrict ~= false
    local inst = UIManager.FindWindow(name)
    if not inst then return false end
    return not isStrict or inst.IsShown or false
end

---ShowView
---@param name string the name RegisterWindow used
function UIManager.ShowView(name, ...)
    return UIManager.ShowOn(LayerView, name, ...)
end

---ShowModal
---@param name string the name RegisterWindow used
function UIManager.ShowModal(name, ...)
    return UIManager.ShowOn(LayerModal, name, ...)
end

---ShowToastView
---@param name string the name RegisterWindow used
function UIManager.ShowToastView(name, ...)
    return UIManager.ShowOn(LayerToast, name, ...)
end

---ShowLoading
---@param name string the name RegisterWindow used
function UIManager.ShowLoading(name, ...)
    return UIManager.ShowOn(LayerLoading, name, ...)
end

---ShowViewTips
---@param toolTips FairyGUI.GObject
---@param delay number
function UIManager.ShowViewTips(toolTips, delay)
    return UIManager.ShowToolTipsOn(LayerView, toolTips, delay)
end

---ShowModalTips
---@param toolTips FairyGUI.GObject
---@param delay number
function UIManager.ShowModalTips(toolTips, delay)
    return UIManager.ShowToolTipsOn(LayerModal, toolTips, delay)
end

---ShowToolTipsOn
---@param layer PluginSet.FGUI.UILayer
---@param toolTips FairyGUI.GObject
---@param delay number
function UIManager.ShowToolTipsOn(layer, toolTips, delay)
    layer:ShowTooltipsWin(toolTips, delay or 0)
    return toolTips
end

---ShowOn
---@param layer PluginSet.FGUI.UILayer
---@param name string the name RegisterWindow used
---@return UIWindowBase|nil
function UIManager.ShowOn(layer, name, ...)
    if not UIManagerNative.IsValid then return end
    local info = s_windowInfos[name]
    if not info then
        --return logError("UIManager.ShowOn: no window info named {0}", name)
        return UIManagerNative.ShowOn(layer, name, ...)
    end
    
    local cls = info.class
    if not cls then
        local suc, winCls = pcall(require, info.classname)
        if not suc or not winCls then
            return logError("UIManager.ShowOn: no lua file named ", info.classname, "\nerror:", winCls)
        end
        cls = winCls
    end
    
    if type(cls) ~= "table" then
        return logError("Cannot open window with ", name)
    end
    info.class = cls
    
    local win ---@type UIWindow
    if info.isSingleton then
        win = cls:GetInstance()
    end
    
    if win then
        win.name = name
        win.Tag = info.tag
        win:TryShowAgain(...)
    else
        win = cls.new(...)
        win.name = name
        win.Tag = info.tag
        win:ShowOn(layer)
    end
    return win
end

-- 显示一个最上层的等待阻挡层
---@param [key] string  钥匙
function UIManager.ShowModalWait(key)
    if not next(s_lockFlags) then
        UIManagerNative.ShowModalWait()
    end
    s_lockFlags[key or "default"] = true
end

-- 隐藏最上层的等待阻挡层
---@param [key] string  钥匙
function UIManager.HideModalWait(key)
    s_lockFlags[key or "default"] = nil
    if not next(s_lockFlags) then
        UIManagerNative.HideModalWait()
    end
end

return UIManager
